div.head: Ine 51
div.ab: XCV. Gif gesiðcund mon londagende fyrd forsitte, gesylle CXX scll' ⁊ þolige his londes; londagende LX scillinga; ceorlisc XXX to fyrdwite.
XCV. Gif gesiðcund mon landagende forsitte fierd, geselle CXX scill. ⁊ ðolie his landes; unlandagende LX scill.; cierlisc XXX scill. to fierdwite.
Si homo siþcundus terram habens (terrarius) fird (expeditionem) supersedeat, emendet C uiginti sol. et perdat terram suam; non habens terram LX sol.; cyrliscus XXX solid. pro fyrdwita.
{XCV} Gif gesiðcund mon landagende forsitte fierd, geselle CXX sciƚƚ ⁊ ðolie his landes; unlandagende LX sciƚƚ; cierlisc XXX sciƚƚ to fierdwite.

If a nobly born man who owns property neglects [his duty to serve] in the army, let him pay 120 shillings and forfeit his land; [a noble] who does not own property, 60 shillings; a man of ceorl-wer, 30 shillings as fyrd-fine.

If a nobleman who holds land neglects military service, he shall pay 120 shillings and forfeit his land; a nobleman who holds no land shall pay 60 shillings ; a commoner shall pay a fine of 30 shillings for neglecting military service.

If a gesith-born man, who owns land, neglects military service, he is to give 120 shillings and to forfeit his land; one who owns no land, 60 shillings, a ceorl 30 shillings, as fine for [neglect of] military service.

Wenn ein Mann vom Gefolgsadel, ein Grundbesitzer, die Heerfahrt versitzt, zahle er 120 Schill. und verliere sein Land [an den Verleiher]; ein [Gefolgsmann] ohne Grundeigenthum 60 Schill.; ein gemeinfreier [Mann] 30 Schill.: als Heer[versäumniss]-Strafe.

If a man of the retainer nobility, a landholder, neglects military service, let him pay 120 shillings and lose his land [to the grantor]; a [retainer] without landed property, 60 shillings; a common [freeman], 30 shillings: as the fine for [neglecting] military service.
